html:
Italian politician who founded Fascism and ruled Italy as dictator from 1922 to 1943.

He began as a socialist journalist but broke with the socialists to back Italy's entry into the First World War. In 1919 he founded the Fascist movement, which mixed nationalism, hatred of socialism and street violence by its blackshirts. In October 1922, after the March on Rome, King Victor Emmanuel III made him prime minister. By 1925 he had banned other parties and made himself dictator, "Il Duce", the leader.

  • In 1929 he signed the Lateran Treaty with the pope, which created Vatican City.
  • In 1935 and 1936 he invaded and conquered the Ethiopian Empire, using poison gas.
  • He allied with Adolf Hitler and entered the Second World War in 1940.

Italy's armies did badly. After the Allies landed in Sicily in 1943, the king dismissed and arrested him. German troops freed him and set him up as head of a puppet state in the north. In April 1945 Italian partisans caught and shot him as he tried to flee. See also World wars.
sum: Italian politician who founded Fascism and ruled Italy as dictator from 1922 to 1943.
